recordType: observational apply-window usage, not controlled experiment

excludedRootInterval.reason: User paused feature work to review a separate PR, then explicitly resumed feature work.

inclusion: Owned numeric token_usage_record.usage events in inclusive timestamp window, matching session_meta.id and payload.thread_id; root and direct subagents; response IDs deduplicated per owning session. Include original/interrupted/resumed/fix/review/docs/UI/race/runtime attempts. Exclude distinguishable PR9 work.
sourceHashMethod: SHA-256 of source file bytes at collection; sourcePrefixBytes fixes reproducible prefix if live source later appends. Records contain numeric usage and technical IDs/hashes only.
limitations: Apply window includes interruptions, waiting, coordination, repair, verification and bookkeeping; elapsed time is not active coding time.
Root belongs to a long chat with inherited history and mixed work; explicit PR9 interval excluded, but remaining root usage cannot be attributed perfectly to feature development.
Inherited foreign-thread records in forked session files are ignored; cumulative snapshots are not summed.
Original and resumed sessions are retained even if interrupted; numeric records flushed after cutoff are absent.
Managed guardian and separate tool/image model usage and charges are unknown, not zero.
Cache and reasoning counts are subsets, not additional tokens. These are client observations, not invoices, credit/currency savings or unique words.
No controlled comparison, benchmark, causal routing claim or cache-benefit claim. Earlier snapshot is preserved; do not fill or silently add its unmeasured gap.

rootCumulativeCrossCheck.method: Final owned token_usage_record.payload.thread_token_usage minus last owned pre-anchor counter; includes excluded root PR interval, so compare to included root plus excluded root only. Never add intermediate cumulative counters.
rootCumulativeCrossCheck.note: apply-kickoff.json preserves an earlier generic counter snapshot at 17:01:03.170Z with different totals. This record uses the owning numeric thread_token_usage boundary at ordinal13963 and response-level usage records, without rewriting the original snapshot.
